card.name: The digit 8 inside reference numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 8 in the middle of long numeric strings such as ISBNs, DOIs, page ranges, PubMed IDs and phone numbers. Usually the 8 follows a 1 or 0 and sits within a citation or contact detail.

modes.label: ISBN and DOI digits
modes.description: An 8 inside the digits of an ISBN or DOI in a reference list.

modes.label: Page and ID numbers
modes.description: An 8 within journal page numbers or PubMed IDs.

modes.label: Phone and address numbers
modes.description: An 8 inside phone numbers or street numbers in contact details.

card.plain: It lights up on the digit 8 buried inside long reference or phone numbers.
